name: Texas Twosome

tenures.source: Wild and Crazy's own GMWE Interview #33, 20 February 2003 (promotions/gmwe/rp/bring-the-pain.html)
tenures.note: Named there by the fed's own text as “the newly formed Texas Twosome,” built as Wild and Crazy's own rivals ahead of that week's ICE; no match survives.

caption: Karl Commons and Brian Davis, formed just in time to be promised a beating by Wild and Crazy's own promo.

name: Wild and Crazy

tenures.source: The fed's own numbered promo titles (“Wild and Crazy VOL 1,” promotions/gmwe/rp/wild-and-crazy-vol-1.html) and their own text, “We are the number one tagteam in this federation. We are the only tagteam in this federation” (promotions/gmwe/rp/bring-the-pain.html)
tenures.note: The fed never billed them under a combined ring name beyond its own promo-board titling; recorded here on that titling and their own repeated claim to be the promotion's only tag team.

caption: GMWE's own only tag team, by its own promo's own words, until Crazy left for another fed in March 2003.

identity.note: The unit name “Wild and Crazy” contains crazy-gmwe's own name as a substring — expected, since Crazy is one of the unit's own two members, not a coincidental collision. Recorded to silence the mint guard's own decorated-aka check.

name: X-Sabbath

identity.note: The portmanteau “X-Sabbath” normalizes as containing “sabbath”/“sabbat,” shared with unrelated characters in other promotions. Nothing connects them; recorded distinct under the collision doctrine.

tenures.role: tag team — one hardcore electric cage match
tenures.source: The Sabbath's own GMWE Interview #2, 4 May 2003 (promotions/gmwe/rp/charisma-get-ready-for-the-pain.html)
tenures.note: Recalled only secondhand, through an arcade-game recreation of “that great match from a few months ago” against The Sweedish Pickles; no card or result survives directly.

caption: The Sabbath and X-Treme, teamed for one hardcore electric cage match against The Sweedish Pickles, recalled secondhand through an arcade cabinet in a later promo.

name: The Sweedish Pickles

tenures.role: tag team — X-Sabbath's own opponent in one hardcore electric cage match
tenures.source: The Sabbath's own GMWE Interview #2, 4 May 2003 (promotions/gmwe/rp/charisma-get-ready-for-the-pain.html)
tenures.note: No individual member's name survives; recalled only secondhand, through an arcade-game recreation of a past match.

caption: Recalled only as X-Sabbath's own opponent in a hardcore electric cage match, with no member's name surviving.
